_how: The only file to edit. Then run: node hub/build.mjs && node hub/check.mjs
status: three lists of short lines. An empty list shows as 'Nothing.' A line is plain text, or { text, href } to make it a link (href: a site path, or #play, #sound, #looks, #docs).
sections > groups > links. Every href and thumb is relative to the site root (hub/site/).
link fields: title, href, see (one line: what you will see). Optional: keys, thumb, also, from.
keys: lines like 'W, S, A, D: paddle and walk'. Keys before the colon, comma-separated.
thumb: a picture in shots/. The build makes game-<name>.jpg and look-<a|b|b2|c>-<name>.jpg.
also: extra small links under a thumbnail, each with title and href.
from: a markdown file (path from the portage folder). The build renders it to the href, which must be docs/<name>.html.
name: Portage
pitch: A browser survival-crafting game. The valley flooded. You have a leaky canoe, and you bolt what you build onto it.

done: Rules engine. Runs with no screen. 179 tests pass. A bot finishes the whole main quest.
Playable game with sound, first in placeholder graphics (greybox).
Three art looks built and reviewed. A Cutbank 50, B Ink & Wash 50, C Blue Hour 45, each out of 60. The reviewer picks B.
B2 built: look B drawn at the screen's full size, with clean pen lines and more drawn detail. Same menus, lobby and HUD.
Luc picked B2 on 2026-11-11. The game gets built in that look.

Step 1 of 3: the real game now draws in B2, with the Ink & Wash lobby, menus and HUD on real game data. 477 tests pass, plus 31 browser tests that press real keys. The bot finishes the main quest in the new look.
running: Bug fix: the player and the canoe stay sharp at every zoom and window size, and the zoomed-out view gets faster (worker Skye). Luc saw the player go blurry when zooming out.
Co-op shape: the rules handle up to 4 players sharing one canoe. F becomes the action key, scavenging takes one press (worker Rex). Solo plays the same.
Next: item icons and the canoe content, then the islands and weather, then co-op networking on sigouin.net.
waiting: Luc: invite the guys to the private GitHub repo (github.com/LucSigouin/portage, Settings, Collaborators).

sections.title: Play
sections.note: The real game in the B2 look, with the Ink & Wash menus and HUD. Rules, quests and sound are in. Still simple stand-ins until step 2: landmarks (steeple, pylons, bridge), the three survivors and three attachments. Storm marks and lantern light come in step 3. Needs a keyboard and mouse: no phone controls yet.
